jsonFormatter.title: JSON formatter & diff
jsonFormatter.description: Format and compare JSON locally in your browser.
jsonFormatter.heading: JSON formatter & diff
jsonFormatter.introduction: Validate, format, minify, or compare JSON without uploading it. Number precision is preserved.
jsonFormatter.inputHint: The diff highlights changed characters as you type once both inputs contain JSON; indentation is ignored. Formatting uses Original JSON. Strict JSON only: no comments, trailing commas, or duplicate keys. Up to 100,000 characters, 2,000 lines, and 100 nesting levels; formatted output has the same size limits.

textDiff.introduction: See what changed between two snippets. Everything stays in your browser.
textDiff.inputHint: Changed characters are highlighted within each line as you type. Empty inputs are allowed. Windows and Unix line endings are treated alike. Up to 100,000 characters and 2,000 lines per input.
textDiff.optionLabel: Ignore leading and trailing whitespace (including the final newline)

mermaid.title: Mermaid diagram editor
mermaid.description: Create diagrams visually with live Mermaid code in a locally hosted Archyne editor.
mermaid.heading: Mermaid diagram editor
mermaid.introduction: Visual editing and live Mermaid code, powered by a locally hosted Archyne editor.
mermaid.recoveryOffMessage: Recovery is off. Save .mmd before leaving.
mermaid.recoveryPendingMessage: A local draft is available. Restore replaces the open diagram; forget removes the saved copy.
mermaid.recoverySavedMessage: Recovery draft saved in this browser.
mermaid.recoveryErrorMessage: Browser storage is unavailable or full. Recovery is paused; use Save .mmd.
mermaid.recoveryLimitMessage: This diagram exceeds the 500,000-character recovery limit. Recovery is paused; use Save .mmd.
mermaid.recoveryRestoreErrorMessage: The draft could not be restored. The saved copy is unchanged; try again or use Open.
mermaid.instructions: Drag a shape onto the canvas, or click it to add. Connect nodes using their handles; with the keyboard, focus a node, press C, then focus another node and press Enter. Use Auto-layout to arrange the diagram. The Mermaid tab contains editable source; on narrow screens, open the code panel from the toolbar.
mermaid.privacyHint: Recovery is opt-in: keep one draft of the current diagram in this browser, up to 500,000 characters. It updates shortly after edits, including unfinished Mermaid text. On your next visit, choose Restore draft or Forget draft. Turning recovery off removes its saved copy. Other open diagrams are not backed up, and a change from another tab pauses recovery here. Use Save .mmd for durable files, Open to resume, and Export for images. No analytics, uploads, or external image/icon requests are allowed.
mermaid.compatibilityHint: This editor is an alpha release. Keep a copy of imported source: visual edits may normalize Mermaid syntax, and some diagram types only support text editing and preview. Obsidian may use a different Mermaid version or layout; common flowchart syntax is the safest choice.

urlInspector.title: URL inspector
urlInspector.description: Inspect and edit URLs locally without visiting them.
urlInspector.heading: URL inspector
urlInspector.introduction: See what is inside a URL, edit query parameters, and remove selected trackers. Nothing is opened, requested, or saved.
urlInspector.inputHint: Paste a full HTTP or HTTPS URL. Outer whitespace is trimmed and browser URL normalization applies to the host and path. Untouched query parameters retain their encoding and order. Up to 16,384 characters and 200 parameters; edits may invalidate signed URLs.
urlInspector.noScriptMessage: Enable JavaScript to inspect URLs. If the controls stay disabled, reload the page.
urlInspector.readyMessage: Paste a URL to get started. It will not be visited.
urlInspector.updatedMessage: {count} query parameters. The edited URL is ready to copy.
urlInspector.limitMessage: The input and edited URL must fit within 16,384 characters and 200 query parameters.
urlInspector.errorMessage: The URL could not be processed. Try changing it or reloading the page.
urlInspector.copyErrorMessage: Could not access the clipboard. Select the edited URL and copy it manually.
urlInspector.parametersHint: Names and values are decoded; + means a space and %2B means a literal plus. Edited entries use percent encoding and name=value syntax. Duplicate and blank names are allowed. Tracker detection recognizes utm_* and common click/analytics IDs, but is not exhaustive; nothing is removed until you select it and choose Remove selected.
urlInspector.invalidMessage: Enter a single-line absolute URL beginning with http:// or https://.
urlInspector.encodingMessage: A query parameter contains invalid percent encoding or Unicode. Correct it before editing or copying the URL.
urlInspector.credentialsMessage: This URL contains credentials. They remain in the output; take care when copying or sharing it.

textUtilities.title: Text utilities
textUtilities.description: Transform and count text locally in your browser.
textUtilities.heading: Text utilities
textUtilities.introduction: Clean up a snippet without replacing the original. Combine options and see the result update as you type.
textUtilities.inputHint: Processing order: case, trim each line, remove blank lines, deduplicate, then sort. Deduplication is case-sensitive after case conversion; sorting uses Unicode code-unit order, not natural numeric order. Line endings become LF, and an existing final newline is kept unless every line is removed. Character counts use Unicode graphemes; word counts use Unicode word boundaries. A final newline does not count as an extra line. Nothing is uploaded or saved.
textUtilities.noScriptMessage: Enable JavaScript to transform text. If the controls stay disabled, reload the page.
textUtilities.readyMessage: Paste text to get started. Options apply to the output only.
textUtilities.updatedMessage: The transformed text is ready to copy or download.
textUtilities.limitMessage: Input and output must fit within 100,000 UTF-16 code units and 2,000 newline-separated lines.
textUtilities.errorMessage: The text could not be processed. Try a smaller snippet or reload the page.
textUtilities.copyErrorMessage: Could not access the clipboard. Select the transformed text and copy it manually.
